title: TI P4-04: Threat Intelligence publication repo scaffold on the packages (brand, theme, infra/site.json)
description:
## Goal
The Threat Intelligence publication repo on the standard scaffold: brand registration, theme, pictograms and video theme in the repo, packages instead of the fork, amplify/backend.ts one-liner, infra/site.json. Mirrors Pilobol.us P3-03 (PPY-af5c03).

## Context (FACT)
- Repo AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence is a GitHub fork of Papyrus (isFork true), public, default branch main, 1 open PR (Kanbus provenance docs). Old Amplify app d3on1y5vlrxmam is connected to it and builds main on every push (last deploy 2026-08-29, commit 9058211). A merge to main therefore rebuilds the OLD live app with scaffold code and would break it: step 1 below prevents that.
- Fork diff vs merge base 95df656: 126 files, +35k/-19k. Brand/content that stays (becomes publication/ and friends): publications/threat_intelligence/{brand.ts, theme.css (2,144 lines), theme-newsroom.css, pictograms/, blog-defense/, seed/, skills/, docs/, tests/, videoml brand parts: ti-title-slide.tsx, ti-quote-card.tsx, ti-video-rhythm.ts, pictogram-video.tsx, browser-bundle.tsx, preview-bundle.tsx}, lib/ti-body-fonts.ts, corpora/*.yml (9 files, 39 KB), public/ brand assets (23 files 5.4 MB), .storybook and src/stories (drop).
- Videos pipeline files (video_pipeline.py, videos_commands.py, videos_dsl.py, seed-video-catalog.ts, scripts/videoml/*) are superseded by `papyrus videos` and the brand.video slot already on develop (PPY-085f79, PPY-961956, closed): do not copy them; keep only the TI scene components and rhythm registered through brand.video.
- Tracked Papyrus version: fork merge base is a 2026-07-02 develop; packages: npm @anthusai/papyrus next = 1.0.0-next.17, PyPI papyrus-newsroom the same version (use the exact current next pin).
- Pilobol.us scaffold shape to copy (read its files with gh api from AnthusAI/Pilobol.us main): papyrus.config.ts with defineSite({ brands: [brand], defaultBrand, backend: {...} }); amplify/backend.ts = defineSiteBackend(site); package.json with next, react, aws-cdk-lib, constructs, @aws-amplify/backend and overrides; infra/site.json.
- Old env: PAPYRUS_ENABLE_CONSOLE_RESPONDER=false, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_SLACK=false; inbound email, storage backups not set and no such resources exist in the old stacks. Keep all four features off (same as Pilobol.us).

## Exact steps
1. (Ryan yes) Before any merge to main: aws amplify update-branch --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --branch-name main --no-enable-auto-build (stops rebuilds of the old app; the deployed build keeps serving). Tag the fork's main as pre-standard-fork. Record the reversal command.
2. Fresh clone of AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence under /Users/home/Projects/, branch feature/standard-scaffold from main.
3. Replace the fork tree with the standard layout: papyrus.config.ts (brand id threat-intelligence, renderer pretext, hosting amplify-ssr, defaultPresentation and forcedPresentation blog, themeTokens and textFont from publications/threat_intelligence/brand.ts, components slots from P4-03, video slot, corpora paths), publication/ (theme.css merged with theme-newsroom.css, pictograms, blog-defense, brand fonts per P4-03, public brand assets), corpora/, skills/, procedures/ (TI-specific only), docs/ (TI-specific only), amplify/backend.ts one-liner, amplify/data/resource.ts per the standard, package.json, tsconfig, .gitignore, AGENTS.md rewritten, README kept (it is the product page).
4. infra/site.json: siteId threat-intelligence, stackName amplify-app-shell-threat-intelligence-cms (new stack beside any old name), repository https://github.com/AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence, brand threat-intelligence, frontend pretext, no hostedZoneId and no domains yet, papyrusVersion pin, cms.staging false, cms.cognitoDomainPrefix papyrus-threat-intelligence (no reserved words), cms.environment with PAPYRUS_EDITION_SLUG current, the four feature flags false, PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS http://localhost:3001/, github block. No secret values in this file (it is public).
5. Keep the TI pictogram, blog-defense and video-script tests; delete tests for code that moved to Papyrus.
6. Local: npm ci, papyrus-app sync, next build against the OLD backend as a Cognito guest (read-only), compare to the P4-01 baseline.

## Acceptance checks
- npm ci --dry-run, typecheck and next build pass; TI's retained tests pass.
- npx papyrus-infra synth --site infra/site.json succeeds; print-buildspec for cms-production shows npm ci, ampx pipeline-deploy and no amplify.yml in the repo.
- Local render of the edition page and 3 articles matches the P4-01 baseline text; screenshots differ only by P4-03's recorded deltas.
- grep of the repo finds no fork-only Papyrus code (app/, lib/, components/ Papyrus copies), no secret values, no real email addresses (placeholders only).
- PR opened against the TI repo main (not merged).

## Rollback
Close the PR; re-enable auto build on the old branch (aws amplify update-branch ... --enable-auto-build).

## Risks
The scaffold PR is huge (deletes most of the fork); review by file class, not line by line. Brand fonts and videos are the likely sources of visual drift.

## Needs Ryan
Yes for step 1 (AWS write); PR review and merge.

## Common rules (Phase 4 Threat Intelligence)
- Plan and facts: the assessment comment on the Phase 4 ticket (PPY-332889). Pattern: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md and docs/standard-site.md 3.2 on origin/develop.
- Ryan: Threat Intelligence is PRE-PRODUCTION; goal is to dogfood the new backend CMS UX before converting anth.us (production). Treat as a hard cutover with brief downtime accepted unless Ryan says otherwise (open question Q1). The OLD app d3on1y5vlrxmam and its backend stay untouched and serving until the retire ticket.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan or on his explicit yes. Read-only AWS calls are fine.
- NEVER use /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us as a build dir. TI repo work: fresh clone under /Users/home/Projects/ (delete afterwards), feature branch + PR, never push to its main. Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus (the board checkout) only run kbs; never git add or commit there.
- Gherkin first for any Papyrus behavior change (AGENTS.md). Long clear names, no line-level comments.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.

Feature branch feature/PPY-504020-packages-scaffold, PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence/pull/10 into scaffold/packages. Pin @anthusai/papyrus 1.0.0-next.19 (includes #150). npm ci, papyrus-app sync, tsc, npm test (3 TI tests), next build pass (build needs a scratch patch for missing bodyIr, see below); papyrus-infra synth OK: App, 2 Branch, Domain (anth.us, prefixes threat-intelligence and threat-intelligence-staging), IAM only, no Repository/AccessToken/OauthToken. Baseline compare: routes match (/ -> /2026/july/04); 3 article texts identical; edition text identical modulo 3 hyphen line-wrap spots; edition full-page height 17648 = baseline when fonts load in time. Finding: Google-loaded brand fonts race Pretext measurement (stale canvas cache, no clearCache on fonts-ready), so some loads wrap with fallback widths (clipped lines, height 17328); Papyrus follow-up. Old tree NOT tagged (tag push not authorized). Videos will not play until P4-14. Scratch outputs and clones deleted.

right_now_summary: The TI scaffold is built and tested; PR #10 is up, with font-loading and video gaps still noted.
